subject: Security sampling coordination for employee onboarding controls
messages:
From: Ayesha Malik <ayesha.malik@bluelinehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC2 sampling ask — onboarding & offboarding controls

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — BlueLine is running the SOC2 scoping for our vendor roster and we need a representative sample of your onboarding/offboarding artifacts to validate controls. Specifically we need: 1) training completion matrix for new hires over the last 12 months (redacted PII ok), 2) confirmation of background-check completion (redacted), 3) a handful of entry/exit timelines showing account deprovisioning evidence and chain-of-custody for credentials, and 4) your guidance on redaction rules.

Can you provide a 20-person sample (mix of engineers, product, sales, and contractors) by COB 2026-11-23? If 20 is too large, a 10-person statistically representative sample with role/tenure stratification will work. We also may ask ClearCheck to validate redactions; cc'ing them.

Deliverable format: a redacted bundle (zipped PDFs/CSV manifest) and a short mapping sheet that ties artifacts to control IDs (we use SOC2 CC3/CC4 mapping).

Let me know if you want us to sign an NDA or provide a temporary viewer link.

Best,
Ayesha Malik
Director, Vendor Assurance
BlueLine Health

Attachments: sample-outline.pdf (reference)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Malik <ayesha.malik@bluelinehealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 sampling ask — onboarding & offboarding controls

Hi Ayesha — thanks for the clear list. We can do a 10-person stratified sample by 2026-11-22 and a fuller 20-person bundle by 2026-11-30 if you prefer. For efficiency, can you confirm you want the sample to prioritize: (a) production-facing engineers & infra, (b) platform/product managers, (c) sales/CS, (d) contingent contractors? We typically include a mix; we also need to know whether contractor identities must be included or if a role-level redaction is acceptable.

I've attached a quick sample-mapping-template.csv (stub) that we'll populate; jonas is helping with the mapping and kim will own redaction guidance. We'll also prepare our bg-check confirmations as redacted attestations (date completed + verification vendor) rather than full reports unless you require the originals.

Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: sample-mapping-template.csv (stub)
From: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC2 sampling ask — onboarding & offboarding controls

Naomi / team — drafting proposed stratified sample below (10 persons):
- 4 engineers (2 senior infra, 2 app) hired across 2026 Q1–Q3
- 2 platform/product (2025 hires)
- 2 sales/CS (including one manager)
- 2 contractors (short-term, <6 months)

For each person we'll provide: training completion snapshot (Learning platform export), BG-check confirmation (redacted vendor attest), account deprovision log excerpt, and a one-line chain-of-custody note for documents.

I've attached bg-redaction-guidelines.md — this is our internal standard for PII masking (names replaced with role tokens, dates truncated to month/year for sensitive records, SSNs fully redacted). If BlueLine needs the raw reports rather than attestations we can request consent and route via ClearCheck (cc).

I propose we assemble the bundle in a temporary Drive folder and share a viewer link; deliverable ETA for the 10-person bundle: 2026-11-22 EOD.

Jonas Weber
Senior Compliance Analyst
Redwood Inference

> On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 11:04 Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > I've attached a quick sample-mapping-template.csv (stub) that we'll populate; jonas is helping with the mapping and kim will own redaction guidance.
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ayesha Malik <ayesha.malik@bluelinehealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, ClearCheck Support <support@clearcheck.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Final: sample delivery plan and next steps — onboarding controls

Ayesha — following up with the agreed plan and timelines.

Summary of scope and deliverables:
- 10-person stratified sample (engineers/platform/sales/contractors) delivered as a redacted bundle.
- Included artifacts per person: learning-platform-export.csv (training completion), bg-check-attestation.txt (vendor + date), account-deprovision-log.pdf (snippet), manifest-row in sample-mapping-template.csv.
- Redaction approach: names -> ROLE_###, DOB truncated to month/year, unique IDs replaced with hashed tokens. See attached bg-redaction-guidelines.md for full rules.

Delivery schedule:
- 2026-11-19: internal redaction pass complete
- 2026-11-21: QA and manifest verification
- 2026-11-22 EOD: final redacted bundle delivered to a temporary Drive folder (link below) and we will send a separate signed attest to ClearCheck if you want third-party validation.

Access & review:
- Drive folder (viewer only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_sample-mapping
- If you prefer DocuSign access gating, we can route with envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e5f6g.

Next steps: please confirm the sample composition above and whether BlueLine requires contractor identities (yes/no). If yes, we'll escalate consent capture to the affected contingent workers. Also propose a 30-minute review call on 2026-11-23 to walk the mapping and controls crosswalk.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: onboarding-sample-delivery.zip (redacted bundle will be placed here), bg-redaction-guidelines.md
